name: cross body twisting crunch
description: A crunch that twists across the body, bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee. It emphasises the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and twist your torso to one side.
Bring your elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down and repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.
